```{r readdata1, echo=FALSE}
dat.tbl <- read.csv("W:/Health Services and Outcomes Research/BEC/Brooke Fridley/consult/Cheng.Nikki/R01 DCIS/rpgm/Chase_rpgm/Summary_Info/Table_S1_62326_CJS.csv")

dat.tbl.adj$Histologic_grade <- case_when(
  dat.tbl.adj$Histologic_grade == 1 ~ "1",
  dat.tbl.adj$Histologic_grade == 2 ~ "2",
  is.na(dat.tbl.adj$Histologic_grade) ~ NA,
  .default = "3"
)

dat.tbl.adj$Nuclear_grade <- case_when(
  dat.tbl.adj$Nuclear_grade == 1 ~ "1",
  dat.tbl.adj$Nuclear_grade == 2 ~ "2",
  is.na(dat.tbl.adj$Nuclear_grade) ~ NA,
  .default = "3"
)
```

## Table 1

```{r table1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

dat.tbl.adj |>
  tbl_summary(include = c(Age, Estrogen_receptor, Progesterone.receptor,
                          HER2_score, Histologic_grade, Nuclear_grade,
                          tumor_fraction),
              by = Diagnosis,
              type = list(Estrogen_receptor = "continuous",
                          Progesterone.receptor = "continuous"),
              label = list(Age ~ "Age (years)",
                           Estrogen_receptor ~ "Estogren Receptor (%)",
                           Progesterone.receptor ~ "Progesterone Receptor (%)",
                           HER2_score ~ "HER2 Score",
                           Histologic_grade ~ "Histologic Grade",
                           Nuclear_grade ~ "Nuclear Grade",
                           tumor_fraction ~ "Proportion of Tumor Cells")
              ) |>
  add_p(test.args = all_continuous() ~ list(exact = FALSE)) |>
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") |>
  bold_labels()


```

## Principal Component Analysis

```{r pca,echo=FALSE}

hilic.B1.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.hilic.B1[,2:(n.metabolites.hilic.B1+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
hilic.B2.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.hilic.B2[,2:(n.metabolites.hilic.B2+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
icms.B1.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.icms.B1[,2:(n.metabolites.icms.B1+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
icms.B2.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.icms.B2[,2:(n.metabolites.icms.B2+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

protein.B1.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.protein.B1[,2:(n.protein.B1+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
protein.B2.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.protein.B2[,1:(n.protein.B2)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
pprotein.B1.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.pprotein.B1[,2:(n.pprotein.B1+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
pprotein.B2.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.pprotein.B2[,1:(n.pprotein.B2)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

hilic.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[, 1:n.hdmb.hilic] <- lapply(hilic.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[, 1:n.hdmb.hilic],
                                                     function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
icms.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[, 1:n.hdmb.icms] <- lapply(icms.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[, 1:n.hdmb.icms],
                                                     function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

data.trans.protein.combine[, 2:(n.protein.combine+1)] <- lapply(data.trans.protein.combine[, 2:(n.protein.combine+1)],
                                                            function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
data.trans.pprotein.combine[, 1:n.pprotein.combine] <- lapply(data.trans.pprotein.combine[, 1:n.pprotein.combine],
                                                              function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

hilic.pc <- prcomp(hilic.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[,1:(n.hdmb.hilic)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
icms.pc <- prcomp(icms.hmdb.combine.IDC.t[,1:(n.hdmb.icms)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)

protein.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.protein.combine[,2:(n.protein.combine+1)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)
pprotein.pc <- prcomp(data.trans.pprotein.combine[,1:(n.pprotein.combine)], center=TRUE, scale=TRUE)


ggplot(hilic.B1.pc$x, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, col=data.trans.hilic.B1$Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Group")) +
  labs(title = "HILIC Batch 1 PCA")
ggplot(hilic.B2.pc$x, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, col=data.trans.hilic.B2$Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Group")) +
  labs(title = "HILIC Batch 2 PCA")
ggplot(icms.B1.pc$x, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, col=data.trans.icms.B1$Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Group")) +
  labs(title = "ICMS Batch 1 PCA")
ggplot(icms.B2.pc$x, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, col=data.trans.icms.B2$Group)) +
```

## Tumor Fractions

```{r fractionplots, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=6}

ggplot(
  data = dat.frac,
  aes(x = Batch_diag, y = tumor_fraction, fill = Batch_diag)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Batch & Diagnosis",
    y = "Tumor Fraction",
    title = "Tumor Fraction by Batch & Diagnosis"
  )

mean_tumor_frac_DCIS_B1 <- dat.frac |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 1 & diagnosis == "DCIS") |>
  dplyr::pull(tumor_fraction) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)
mean_tumor_frac_DCIS_B2 <- dat.frac |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 2 & diagnosis == "DCIS") |>
  dplyr::pull(tumor_fraction) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)
mean_tumor_frac_IDC_B1 <- dat.frac |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 1 & diagnosis == "IDC") |>
  dplyr::pull(tumor_fraction) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)
mean_tumor_frac_IDC_B2 <- dat.frac |>
  dplyr::filter(Batch == 2 & diagnosis == "IDC") |>
  dplyr::pull(tumor_fraction) |>
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

ttest_Batch1 <- t.test(tumor_fraction ~ diagnosis, data = subset(dat.frac, Batch == 1))
ttest_Batch2 <- t.test(tumor_fraction ~ diagnosis, data = subset(dat.frac, Batch == 2))

ttest_DCIS <- t.test(tumor_fraction ~ Batch, data = subset(dat.frac, diagnosis == "DCIS"))
ttest_IDC <- t.test(tumor_fraction ~ Batch, data = subset(dat.frac, diagnosis == "IDC"))

paste0("Mean Tumor Fraction: DCIS & Batch 1 = ", round(mean_tumor_frac_DCIS_B1,4))
paste0("Mean Tumor Fraction: IDC & Batch 1 = ", round(mean_tumor_frac_IDC_B1,4))

paste0("Mean Tumor Fraction: DCIS & Batch 2 = ", round(mean_tumor_frac_DCIS_B2,4))
paste0("Mean Tumor Fraction: IDC & Batch 2 = ", round(mean_tumor_frac_IDC_B2,4))

paste0("DCIS vs. IDC: Batch 1 P-value (t-test) = ",round(ttest_Batch1$p.value,5))
paste0("DCIS vs. IDC: Batch 2 P-value (t-test) = ",round(ttest_Batch2$p.value,5))

paste0("DCIS: Batch 1 vs. Batch 2 P-value (t-test) = ",round(ttest_DCIS$p.value,5))
paste0("IDC: Batch 1 vs. Batch 2 P-value (t-test) = ",round(ttest_IDC$p.value,5))


```
